event_records.description: Ravi and the seller are aware of each other's positions: Ravi has made an offer 40,000 rupees below the seller's asking price, and the seller has not yet accepted or countered.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.persona_brief:
You are Ravi.
Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback. He is 40,000 rupees below the seller's asking price. He has three days before the listing expires.

seller.name: Seller
seller.persona_brief:
You are Seller.
The seller has listed a 2019 hatchback at a certain price. They are 40,000 rupees above Ravi's offer. The listing expires in three days.

resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller agreed on a price (e.g., a binding acceptance or signed agreement) before 2026-08-23T10:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
